title: Rabbit's Escape
description: Two craftable teleportation items: White Rabbit's Escape teleports you to spawn, Black Rabbit's Regret teleports you to your last death location.
body:
**Follow the White Rabbit home. Chase the Black Rabbit into regret.** Two enchanted rabbit's feet offer escape when you need it most: ⚪ **White Rabbit's Escape** - Consume to follow the rabbit back to safety, teleporting you to your respawn point no matter how far you've wandered. ⚫ **Black Rabbit's Regret** - Eat to retrace the rabbit's final steps, returning you to the place where you last fell, even across dimensions. The **White Rabbit** brings you comfort and familiarity, while the **Black Rabbit** forces you to face your mistakes with darkness and withering effects. **Notes:**
*The White Rabbit recipe requires skeleton skulls, so this pack gives them a 2.5% drop chance (affected by Looting up to 5.5%) to make crafting it possible.
*Recipes can be found in the datapack's .zip archive. --- **Credits:** Based on [Recall Potion](https://modrinth.com/datapack/ly-recall-potion) by [lullaby6](https://github.com/lullaby6/data-packs). Licensed under [AGPL-3.0](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/agpl-3.0.html#license-text).
